ayahOccurrences.text: وَشَرَوْهُ بِثَمَنٍۭ بَخْسٍ دَرَٰهِمَ مَعْدُودَةٍ وَكَانُوا۟ فِيهِ مِنَ ٱلزَّٰهِدِينَ
ayahOccurrences.highlightedHtml: وَشَرَوْهُ بِثَمَنٍۭ بَخْسٍ دَرَٰهِمَ مَعْدُودَةٍ وَكَانُوا۟ فِيهِ مِنَ ٱلزَّٰهِدِينَ

lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: ٱلزَّٰهِدِينَ is in the derivative form: زاهِدين
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
ز/ﻫ/د   z–h–d to abstain, to renounce, to abandon, to forsake (pleasures and wealth), to withdraw. Of this root,زاهِدين zāhidın occurs 1 time in the Qur’an
.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
زاهِدين zāhidın [pl. of n./act. part. زاهِد zāhid] abstemious, abstinent, one who has no interest in worldly pleasures, one who has little or no interest in something

(12:20) وَشَرَوْهُ بِثَمَنٍ بَخْسٍ دَرَاهِمَ مَعْدُودَةٍ وَكَانُوا فِيهِ مِنَ الزَّاهِدِينَ and they sold him for a lowly price, a few dirhams, and they were not interested in him.
